title: Paper Cut Master
description: Slice colored origami sheets with one clean geometric cut to match exact target silhouettes and drop excess pieces cleanly away.
controls: Press and drag across the paper sheet to draw a straight cut line and carve out the required shape.

zh-CN.title: 剪纸大师
zh-CN.description: 创意物理切割益智剪纸大师：看准目标虚线一刀利落裁开彩色折纸，考验空间直觉与精准手感超级解压！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动拉出直线一刀裁剪彩纸，精准切出目标图案与比例即可完美过关。
